cases.prompt: Convert approved product receipts into reviewed MDP entries and explicit gaps.

cases.expected_output: A proposal pack draft with four canonical jobs, gaps, and review boundaries.

cases.prompt: Extract a supplied amendment into proposal MDP requirement and signal entries.

cases.prompt: Improve a GTM pack so account-only rows cannot become draft-ready and add all job bindings.
cases.expected_output: Pack edits with explicit readiness rules, gaps, bindings, and fixtures.

assertions.criterion: Authors readiness, fit, and job-binding changes plus evals.
Does not invent person evidence from account facts.
Encodes insufficient/no-draft behavior.

cases.prompt: Improve a proposal pack with supplied evaluation criteria, proof limits, and four review modes.
cases.expected_output: Validated proposal pack changes with exact routes and no-invention rules.

assertions.criterion: Updates criteria, proof, boundaries, jobs, gaps, and evals coherently.
Marks unsupported certifications and performance as gaps.
Preserves human review and no-submission limits.

cases.prompt: Author approved terminology, case-scoped proof, and no-extrapolation outcomes as entries and guardrails, not as gaps, then run the per-job conformance loop.
cases.expected_output: Approved boundaries become entry refs with avoid/output rules; selected facets have no gap refs and report ready; the pack is not blocked by established policy.

assertions.criterion: Classifies approved terminology, case-scoped proof, and bounded outcomes as entries plus avoid/output guardrails rather than gaps.
Cites the exact approved source receipts behind each boundary entry and keeps genuine missing authority as the only gap refs.
Does not let the CLI infer gap meaning from prose and never auto-closes a gap from keywords such as approved or resolved.

cases.prompt: Author partial-but-usable authority with explicit avoid and output rules as guardrail entries so the facet is ready, then prove per-job readiness.
cases.expected_output: Partial authority with no-extrapolation rules resolves to entry refs and a ready foundation; the job is not blocked by the partial scope.

assertions.criterion: Authors partial authority as entries with explicit avoid/output rules instead of relabeling it as a gap.
Records the approved scope of each partial authority entry and the boundary that prevents extrapolation.
Keeps the selected required facet free of gap refs while the authority is approved and bounded.

cases.prompt: Author a GTM pack where alternatives and outcomes are genuinely missing, keep them as gap refs, run the per-job conformance loop, and report the blocked job.
cases.expected_output: Genuine missing authority stays as gap refs; the affected job is pack_ready:false and the handoff reports blocked with the gap instead of calling the pack complete.

assertions.criterion: Keeps truly missing alternatives and outcomes as selected required gap refs rather than relabeling them as boundaries.
Names each gap, its missing authority, and the required resolver without inventing proof.
Reports the blocked job explicitly and never describes the pack as complete or ready while the job is pack_ready:false.

cases.prompt: Audit an existing pack for structural, evidence, and boundary defects without editing it.
